Retain direct sidecars for richer product semantics and for permanent noncomparable contracts.

Do not delete direct paths in the initial promotion.

current_opportunity_decision_context and daily_opportunity_decision_queue, because packet priority_tier and eligible_strategies are distinct from daily prioritization fields.

findings.answer_4_historical_packet_only_risk: The 436 historical PACKET_ONLY cells are not a cutover blocker: the packet is present and its component remains usable while the direct sibling is absent. They do require retained direct fallback and sidecar review because packet-only transport availability is not proof that every richer direct historical presentation field is represented.
findings.answer_5_scenario_coexistence: YES_PERMANENT: packet current_evidence_bound_scenario Bear/Base/Bull and direct current_research_scenario_context CONSERVATIVE/BASE/SPECULATIVE are distinct deterministic contracts.
findings.answer_6_opportunity_priority_coexistenc: YES_PERMANENT_DIRECT_CONSUMPTION: 1,507 DUAL_NONCOMPARABLE_SEMANTICS records preserve the distinction between packet priority_tier/eligible_strategies and daily opportunity prioritization. Neither may override the other.
findings.answer_7_rollback: A future packet-primary change must be a single explicit configuration/default reversal to LEGACY_DIRECT, retain direct sidecars and the parity artifact, and locally suppress only affected packet components. Roll back immediately on a new comparable conflict, malformed/unresolved packet component, missing packet coverage, nonzero unexplained residual, or violated scenario-separation invariant.
findings.answer_8_telemetry: Keep the deterministic market-wide parity artifact, component breakdown, source identities, packet/direct coverage, conflict and malformed counts, unresolved counts, scenario-separation invariant, and residual reconciliation for every governed packet-primary release.
findings.answer_9_prohibited_claims: All existing authority prohibitions remain: no probability, expected return, target, intrinsic value, BUY/SELL/HOLD, new action vocabulary, scalar risk score, sizing, capacity, leverage, PIT, or RAW_AS_TRADED authority.
findings.answer_10_owner_approval_blocker: NO_CURRENT_TECHNICAL_OR_INTEGRITY_BLOCKER_TO_REQUEST_OWNER_APPROVAL. Owner approval remains required because the scope and semantics of a default transport change are an architecture decision.

owner_decision.requested_decision: Whether to authorize a separate bounded implementation of PACKET_PRIMARY with the retained coexistence, fallback, parity, and rollback controls in this artifact.
